stem.text: The number of people inside a museum is modeled by \( N(t) = 80 - 35 e^{- \frac{t}{5}} \) people, for \( 0 \le t \le 15 \), where t is measured in minutes. Using a calculator, find \( N'(3) \), showing the setup, and interpret the value in the context of the problem with correct units. Give the value correct to three decimal places.

answer_key.label: \( N'(3) = 3.842 \), so at time t = 3 minutes the number of people inside the museum is increasing at a rate of 3.842 people per minute.

worked_solution.text: Differentiate the model to get the rate, \( N'(t) = 7 e^{- \frac{t}{5}} \).
With a calculator, \( N'(3) = 3.842 \) to three decimal places.
worked_solution.rule_named: evaluate the derivative at the instant

worked_solution.text: The value is positive, so at time t = 3 minutes the number of people inside the museum is increasing at a rate of 3.842 people per minute.
worked_solution.rule_named: sign of the rate gives the direction of change

options.label: \( N'(3) = 3.842 \), so when the number of people inside the museum is 3 people it is increasing at a rate of 3.842 people per minute.
